statement: Bind the third semantic editing verb: scope-aware rename of ANY def-sited symbol (top-level function, class, module binding over Assign/AnnAssign, class method, nested function) at exact byte spans with provable-binding-only propagation across files. Laws harvested and extended: only uses that provably resolve to the same binding are renamed (shadowed inner bindings keep the old name and are recorded); dynamic receivers, getattr dispatch and unattributable attribute sites are listed in unknown_sites and lower complete, never silently edited. Cross-file propagation covers from-import name tokens (alias untouched; `import top as apex` lawfully becomes `import apex as apex`) and import-module attribute sites. Method renames cover self/cls/C.m inside the class and module-level C.m outside; super() references are never touched. New inheritance law: REFUSE_INHERITED_OVERRIDE when a subclass redefines the renamed method, REFUSE_INHERITED_USE when a subclass inherits and calls it -- the silent-break shape renames create. Collision law: NEW_NAME_COLLIDES on defs, module bindings, nested scopes and same-module import aliases; global/nonlocal declarations on the old name refuse REFUSE_NONLOCAL_OR_GLOBAL; locals/params/class-assigns refuse SYMBOL_KIND_UNSUPPORTED (rename_parameter owns params). Every splice verified against the original bytes (SPAN_INTEGRITY); strings and substring-carriers are never edited. A named pytest suite referees post-edit; red restores every original byte and refuses TESTS_RED_AFTER_EDIT; no tests named => verified=false loudly. Golden: world pkg/core.py def top -> apex with a cross-file caller (from-import + import-module attribute) and a named referee suite: 5 edits across 3 files, gate PASS verified=true, e2e 218 ms; aliaser `from pkg.core import top as apex` becomes `import apex as apex` and keeps resolving. Rollback leg: tampered named suite -> TESTS_RED_AFTER_EDIT with sha256-exact restoration. Determinism: two pristine worlds byte-identical. Pin suite 18/18 x 3. Census 418 -> 419, registry 124 -> 125.
